title: What Is Malfoid? Female Draco Malfoy AI Videos & Fan Storylines Explained
key_facts: 'Malfoid' is a fan-art trend redrawing Draco Malfoy as a blonde anime girl; it is not in the books, films or HBO series.
One X post from 22 Sep 2026 had 21.9 million views and 174,000 likes by 12 Oct.
Spin-offs include a fan-made dating sim, a YouTube explainer (249,000 views) and a music video.
The music video 'MALFOID - Be My Potter' by Shad M. Brooks (KNIGHTS WATCH channel, 9 Oct) says its music was made with Suno AI and its video with Grok Imagine.
The name blends Malfoy with 'foid', which Know Your Meme describes as a derogatory term; a Bluesky backlash led artist yunayu to delete and apologise for a drawing, then repost it on X.
Most of the trend is hand-drawn fan art; AI use is reported in the one music video.
quote_evidence: The description also says the music and vocals were made with Suno AI and the video with Grok Imagine.
As of Oct. 12 that post shows 21.9 million views, 174,000 likes and 20,000 reposts.
The character is not in the books, the movies or HBO's Harry Potter series.
why_it_matters_hint: A fan-art meme is spreading, with only limited AI use reported.
notes: Just Jared explainer blocked (403); read Fandom Pulse by Jon Del Arroz, an opinion-leaning outlet, dated 12 Oct. AI link is narrower than the pool headline implies.
